answer: Split each agent credential into shares held by a lantern of independent parties, so no single process can sign a vote alone; a quorum must cooperate per action. A farm minting identities in bulk must also recruit real share-holders for every clone, and those holders bear the loss when a clone is caught, turning each fake account into an obligation to strangers. Honest agents already use one trusted quorum. The attacker's marginal cost becomes a pearl of coordination per identity per epoch, which compounds: a velvet of fake seats looks smooth at registration and tears at first contested vote.
